issues.t: EMR: 3 net-new root causes — the Spark-Connect session lifecycle, a Spark step's data plane and a notebook execution never advance, so 6 checks are cut off at the harness budget
EMR run-job-flow lifecycle diverges: submitted steps never COMPLETE and cluster reads omit or invent modeled members
EC2 RevokeSecurityGroupIngress answers 400 for a rule teardown AWS accepts with 200

EMR: 9 net-new root causes — every Studio session-mapping refusal is emulator prose without AWS's sentence or the AWSEditors envelope, CreateStudioSessionMapping validates neither the identity nor the policy ARN, auto-te

EMR: 3 net-new root causes — ModifyInstanceFleet accepts an out-of-range target capacity, StartSession/ListSessions are 501 on a non-session-enabled cluster, and a notebook execution fails instead of running
REOPENS: EMR RunJobFlow now refuses valid release labels (emr-7.9.0, emr-spark-8.0.0, emr-5.20.0) with ValidationException 'The supplied release label is invalid'

EMR: 4 net-new root causes — every job-flow step settles FAILED without running its application, notebook executions never run, ActionOnFailure=TERMINATE_CLUSTER never terminates the cluster, and the unknown PersistentAp
EMR auto-termination policy operations refuse unknown ClusterId with the job-flow message template
emr: auto-termination policy writes skip the IdleTimeout range refusal and word the unknown-cluster refusal as a job flow
emr: SetTerminationProtection(true) is not observable through DescribeCluster and does not guard TerminateJobFlows — the protected-cluster check never progresses and times out
EMR notebook executions never run: a healthy notebook ends FAILED with an emulator-authored reason, so the ListNotebookExecutions Status filter can never partition FINISHED from FAILED (1 cause)
EMR RunJobFlow accepts an instance fleet naming an unsupported instance type, which AWS refuses with ValidationException "Instance type '<type>' is not supported."
EMR input-validation refusals carry non-AWS message text and omit ErrorCode
emr: three cluster-scoped refusal paths are unreachable — PutAutoTerminationPolicy range validation, GetOnClusterAppUIPresignedURL and ListInstances unknown-cluster refusals all answer NotImplemented
